items.description: Home's "Record a tasting" opens the tasting pen (decide-home-record-tasting-opens-pen, open-pen): in app/src/ui/RecipeList.jsx the AWAITING_TASTING "Record a tasting" Link (around line 209-214) navigates to tastingPath with no route state, so the batch log opens with the pen closed; pass state={{ startTasting: true }} on that Link so the batch page's useRouteIntents (startTastingOnMount reads location.state?.startTasting) opens the tasting pen on arrival, exactly as useBatchRecording.js line 328 does for the recipe page's band; the "Keep developing" link is unchanged; add a RecipeList test asserting the link carries that state (and update any test that pins the link without state). Own commit; full suite must pass (baseline 114 files, 3471 tests).

Ingredients place below 760: source on its own line (look-p9-012-redraw approved; sketch 012 README decision 5, decide-p9-393-source-own-line): in app/src/styles/shell.css inside the existing @media (max-width: 759.98px) block, change `.place .ing__figures tr` (line ~722) grid-template-areas from `'fig amt' 'basis src'` to `'fig amt' 'basis basis' 'src src'`, and `.place .ing__figures .ing__source` (line ~753) text-align from right to left; nothing else moves, no new token; the authority is .planning/sketches/012-places/ingredients-place.html (the .pc393 .place rules at lines 6686-6687) and .planning/sketches/012-places/README.md decision 5; update any stylesheet test that pins the old areas. Own commit; full suite must pass.

Ingredients place: lactose line on any entry with milk solids (look-p9-012-redraw approved; sketch 012 README decision 6, decide-p9-lactose-line-non-dairy, any-milk-solids): in app/src/ui/IngredientsPlace.jsx the helper line "Lactose counts as 54.5% of milk solids in Freezing and Sweetness." (line ~301) renders only when fields.dairy; it must render whenever the entry holds a Milk solids figure (Number.isFinite(entry.composition.msnf), the same test heldFigures uses) or dairy === true, so the Milk Chocolate entry (flavor, 16% milk solids, not dairy) shows it; keep the wording; add IngredientsPlace tests for a non-dairy entry with msnf (line shown) and a non-dairy entry without msnf (no line); update the 09-places-check expectations under .planning/phases/09-*/ only if they pin the old condition. Own commit; full suite must pass.
